wholePhysicalScope: The native 78-vertex palace way fixes the main residence, two attached forecourt wings and the open horseshoe. The central entrance node and five marked wing entries are retained as controls.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the three-storey residence, bell-roof pavilions and two red-roofed wings around the open forecourt. Closer levels refine pilasters, sash, parapets, dormers and both entrances.
limitations: The principal palace and connected wings follow the original native plan. Height, minor roof limits, statues, architectural relief and bay spacing are proportional estimates from the cleared photographs.
The original provider terrain is unchanged. Entry thresholds and local foundations are approximate. The outer gate, formal gardens, boundary structures, and interiors are outside this model.
The summer 2023 permanent exterior uses two Qualla photographs and three independently confirmed CC0 courtyard images by the same photographer.
